count_notes: creatures = monsters.csv rows (wc minus 2 header rows); also 199 GameEpicBoss classes in 167 files (grep, unchecked for live use); classes = 15 base + 16 Albion + 17 Hibernia + 15 Midgard files; weapons = server-side epic set pieces only; zones = Zones.xml rows (344 region rows in Regions.xml)
creature_families: Realm field mobs: AlbionMobs 21 files, HiberniaMobs 16, MidgardMobs 9, custom helpers 5 (scripts/mobs)
Named and epic bosses: scripts/namedmobs, 31 entries; Dragons 8 files, DarknessFalls 10, Trollheim 5, Fomor 4
Special AI creatures: ai/brain/Special, 6 files (storm-scaled elemental, storm-latched globule swarm, stealth ambusher, walk-away boss, spawner)
Idle and atmosphere mobs: ShiveringPresence (idle pulse), Strangler (aura every 3 s)
Disguise mobs: Myling (ghost-flag disguise, reveal on first strike), Changeling (re-rolls look and size)
Clock mobs: TimeDependentSpawnNpc with DaySpawn and NightSpawn

top_creatures.label: Stepped sky boss
top_creatures.why: Health-stepped breath ladder, capped and spaced add summons ringed around the target, a flight watchdog; the boss telegraphs its own phase changes
top_creatures.keep: health-stepped signature attacks; total summon cap (not concurrent); spacing between summons; ring placement with a floor check
top_creatures.change: one cursor for the ladder instead of nine flags; our own breath shape; no flight route in the fight

top_creatures.label: Storm-grown elemental
top_creatures.why: Size and strength scale with a passing storm front; a rain cue and an effect repeated to nearby players
top_creatures.keep: intensity tiers drive size and strength; the creature visibly reacts to the world
top_creatures.change: our own storm from zone data; our own tier table; a clamp on size

top_creatures.label: Storm-latched globule swarm
top_creatures.why: A lake of small spheres that grow once when a storm crosses, then stay grown
top_creatures.keep: the latch as a one-time phase change
top_creatures.change: our own trigger (event, not a storm pass), our own size and level, a visible colour cue

top_creatures.label: Ambusher hidden until first hit
top_creatures.why: Stealthed creature that drops stealth on its first attack, so the player learns the rule from one hit
top_creatures.change: reveal by a ground ripple and a sound cue, not a flag flip

top_creatures.label: Veil shade
top_creatures.why: Looks like a plain ghost until attacked, then shows a random shape from a short list; reverts when the fight stops
top_creatures.keep: disguise and reveal on attack; revert on disengage
top_creatures.change: our own shape list; no ghost flag; a short reveal animation

top_creatures.label: Re-rolling shapeshifter
top_creatures.why: Changes model and size on a Util.Chance(10) roll per think (a 10 percent roll: GameServer/gameutils/Util.cs:48-51), so the player never gets a stable read
top_creatures.change: roll only out of combat; our own size range; a telegraph before the change

top_creatures.label: Clock-bound creature
top_creatures.why: Appears by day or by night, decided by the zone clock, and never flips while a fight is on
top_creatures.keep: visibility gated by a clock; flip only out of combat
top_creatures.change: our own visibility cue (a dim glint by day); clock in zone data

top_creatures.label: Haunting pulse
top_creatures.why: Idle creature that sends a small effect to nearby players at a random 6 to 20 s gap; cheap way to make a zone feel alive
top_creatures.keep: random idle beat with triangular timing
top_creatures.change: our own pulse shape and colour; slower beat in big zones

classes: Base archetypes (15 files, playerclasses/base): Acolyte, Disciple, Elementalist, Fighter, Forester, Guardian, Mage, Magician, Mystic, Naturalist, Seer, Stalker, Viking, plus the two rogue bases
Albion specialisations (16): e.g. Armsman from Fighter, Cabalist from Mage, Infiltrator from rogue base
Hibernia specialisations (17): e.g. Bainshee from Magician (timed form on offensive casts, ClassBainshee.cs:45,95,152), Ranger from Stalker (spell lines on training), Sluaghbinder from Acolyte (pets)
Midgard specialisations (15): e.g. Hunter from the Midgard rogue base (spell lines on training), Valkyrie and Berserker from Viking, Runemaster from Mystic
Races: eRace enum (Enums/eRace.cs), 25 lines with a value including Unknown; realm mapping not read
Factions: three realms (Albion, Hibernia, Midgard), split by folder
weapon_families: Server-side epic set weapons: mace (crush), shield (thrust type, one-hand off-hand), scythe (slash, two-hand); SluaghbinderEpicArmor.cs:53 and related lines
Pet weapons installed by tools/pet-art (install_pet_weapons.py, paint_pet_weapons.py); README.md:31
Damage types: physical Natural, Crush, Slash, Thrust (0-3); magic Body, Cold, Energy, Heat, Matter, Spirit (10-15); Enums/eDamageType.cs:26-40
Main item table (items.csv, about 2,848 rows): header only, not read
gear_tiers: Dubh Sluagh epic set: ten pieces (six armour slots, mantle, three weapons plus shield); damage per AF 102 on armour, 165 on weapons (SluaghbinderEpicArmor.cs:29-65)
Set items built at level 51 (SluaghbinderEpicArmor.cs:92); pet-art README calls the set a level 50 reward (README.md:32), mismatch noted
No set-count bonus found; set items refuse dye (GamePlayerInventory.cs:1121)
Utility score per piece with stat weights (SluaghbinderEpicArmor.cs:78-86): 1 per point default, 0.25 max health, 2 power pool and resist percent, 5 shield skill
Catacombs armour line: skin and tint variants per body; client tables not read in detail (pet-art README.md:50)
zones: Zone rows: 473 (dbupdater/insert/Zones.xml); lava flag on 7 rows (Zones.xml:710,728,1484,1502,1844,2492,2510)
Realm, experience and water level are 0 in every zone row of this copy (Zones.xml:19 shape), so zone tuning is not in the box
Region rows: 344; diving enabled 27; housing 3; frontier 1 (Regions.xml)

Dungeon archetypes by folder: dragon lairs (3), Darkness Falls lords, Trollheim, Fomor, glacier (TuscarianGlacier, GlacierGiant), caverns (MarfachCaverns, HallOfTheCorrupt), SummonersHall, Avalon Isle lake
Weather front: a storm band of width 25000-90000, speed 100-700, intensity 30-110 sweeps a region (RegionWeather.cs:117-119,162,174)
Hazards: lava zones, moving storm band, dragon lift throws, stealth ambushers, day and night spawns

looks.label: Storm pulse on creatures
looks.technique: periodic animation event sent to nearby players every think inside a storm (effect id 2976); not a shader

looks.label: Storm buff roll on globules
looks.technique: small effect id 6053 on a one-in-five roll during a storm

looks.label: Idle pulse
looks.technique: effect id 152 every 6 to 20 s, random beat

looks.label: Periodic aura
looks.technique: effect id 5206 every 3 s to nearby players

looks.label: Buff overlay with readable pulse (planned)
looks.technique: tinted overlay tied to an armour buff; preview notes it lacks a buildup halo and a visual pulse

looks.label: Three-stage summon cast effect
looks.technique: hand glow L and R, hand burst, target explosion as private effect rows

looks.label: Named wind-up phases
looks.technique: load start, load end, fire start, fire end, release point as timed phases

looks.label: Effect attach table
looks.technique: effect spec per attach node: max visible range, rate, axis, collide

looks.label: In-place model and size re-roll
looks.technique: model and size swap in place on a roll

looks.label: Flag-based disguise
looks.technique: ghost flag hides the true form until attacked

originals.name: Moving storm band
originals.idea: A timed band of fog crosses a zone at a set speed and width; creatures inside grow or glow
originals.keep: timed moving band, creatures react inside it, speed and width as zone data
originals.change: our fog wall is a minimap sweep; our creatures and numbers are our own

originals.name: Stepped sky warden
originals.idea: A boss with a breath at each 10 percent health step, one per tick
originals.keep: health-stepped signature attack, one per tick
originals.change: one cursor, our own breath, no flight route

originals.name: Capped brood ring
originals.idea: Total summons capped per fight, spaced, placed in a ring around the player and checked against the floor
originals.keep: total budget, spacing, ring placement with floor check
originals.change: our own add roster; ring is around the player, not the boss

originals.name: Veil shade
originals.idea: Looks like a plain shape until first strike, then takes a random form from a short list
originals.keep: reveal on attack, revert on disengage
originals.change: our own forms list and reveal animation; no ghost flag

originals.name: Grow-once globule
originals.idea: A creature that grows one time when a trigger passes and stays grown
originals.change: our own trigger (event), size and colour

originals.name: Clock-bound stalker
originals.idea: Visible only in a time window set by zone data; changes only outside combat
originals.keep: visibility by clock, no flip in combat

originals.name: Haunting beat
originals.idea: A random idle pulse every 6 to 20 s to nearby players
originals.change: our own pulse shape and colour

originals.name: Wraith stance
originals.idea: A timed form that starts on an offensive cast and refreshes on each cast, reverting on zone change
originals.keep: timed stance refreshed by offence; revert on zone change
originals.change: our own stance look (glass cloak); no race-specific model swap
